messages.subject: Project Solstice - Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement (v1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Please find attached the first draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement for Larkmoor's Series A. Investor Rights Agreement and amended articles to follow shortly. Look forward to your mark-up.

Key commercial terms reflect the signed term sheet (£8m subscription, £4.00 per share, 2,000,000 Series A Preferred, 25.0% fully diluted).

Best,
